hero.headline: Coffee Roasted the Morning It Ships
hero.subheadline: We roast in 12-pound batches on the Charleston waterfront and get your bag in the mail within 48 hours. No warehouse, no months-old beans, just coffee at its peak.

logo_bar.headline: Proudly served by independents across the Lowcountry

steps.headline: From Green Bean to Your Cup
steps.subheadline: Four steps, no shortcuts. This is why the roast date on our bags is measured in days, not months.

items.title: Source
items.desc: We buy direct from family farms in Honduras, Ethiopia, and Sumatra, and we pay above fair trade rates for every lot we bring in.

items.title: Roast
items.desc: Beans hit the drum the same morning your order comes in. Small 12-pound batches, profiled by hand, logged roast by roast.

items.title: Rest
items.desc: Every roast rests a full day so the CO2 settles and the flavor opens up before it gets anywhere near a bag.

items.title: Ship
items.desc: Bagged with a one-way valve and in the mail within 48 hours of roasting. Most orders arrive within two days.

testimonials.headline: What Our Subscribers Say
testimonials.subheadline: Real notes from the people who drink it every morning.

items.quote: The Kiawah blend ruined hotel coffee for me forever. You can taste the difference a fresh roast date makes.
items.name: Marcie Tolan

items.quote: I switched our cafe to Harbor & Pine last spring and customers noticed within a week. Wholesale support has been outstanding too. They helped us dial in our espresso recipe and even trained two of our baristas on the new grinder.
items.name: Dre Wilkins

items.quote: Best decaf I have ever had. Period.
items.name: Sam Okafor

items.quote: Their single-origin Ethiopia tastes like blueberries. I did not believe the bag until I brewed it.
items.name: Priya Nair

items.quote: We send Harbor & Pine gift boxes to clients every December and people start asking about them by October. The packaging is beautiful and the coffee backs it up.
items.name: Caroline Hsu

cta_final.headline: Your First Bag Ships Free
cta_final.description: Pick a roast, pick a schedule, cancel whenever you want. Freshness is the whole point.
cta_final.trust_line: Free shipping on subscriptions. Skip or cancel anytime.
